svg.title: Meet your fall friends — step 3: Dress your fall friend
svg.desc: Overlap leaves over the body to make a dress, coat or tunic. Add leaf wings, a hat or colourful hair. Use each leaf’s natural shape, or ask a grown-up before making small cuts with child-safe scissors.

text.font-family: Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Try a skirt, a dress, wings or a colourful hairstyle.
